lines.zh: 我踮着脚，在石阵间穿行。
lines.en: I pick my way between the stones on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面上哒哒响。
lines.en: My claws tap on the ground.
I break into a trot, tail straight.
I leap over a slab.
My head keeps scanning side to side.

lines.zh: 我踩着石棱，往箱子那边走。
lines.en: I step along the stone ledge toward the chest.
My feathers ruffle a little.
Each step lands precisely.

lines.zh: 我从别的恐龙身边跑过。
lines.en: I run past the other dinosaurs.

lines.zh: 我小跑两步，又停下嗅地。
lines.en: I trot two steps, then stop to sniff the ground.
My toes grip the ground well.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转到石柱后面。
lines.en: I work around behind the pillar.
I keep low, out of sight.
I move ahead of the pack leader.
I crouch, bobbing my head.
I'm honing my claws.
A stone clicks; I listen.
Several of us huddle together.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，尾巴伸得笔直。
lines.en: I break into a trot, tail straight out.
I watch the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 我在石板缝里嗅来嗅去。
lines.en: I sniff around the cracks in the flagstones.
I wait for the leader's signal.
My tail flicks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地张开嘴，打哈欠。
lines.en: I open my jaw in a slow yawn.
There's a draft; I sniff.
I count the others.
I tuck my toes beneath me.
The leader is a size larger.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，也只到你腰。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and still reach only your waist.
I tilt my head at your hands.
That thing on you shines.
I edge back toward my own.
Several of us are watching you.
Don't move too fast.

lines.zh: 箱子里的食物，我拿走了。
lines.en: The food in that chest is gone.
You're in our way.
This primordial cave is ours.
I take one small step forward.

lines.zh: 我们几只在你脚边散开。
lines.en: A few of us fan out at your feet.
I'm not sure whether to fear you.
Your boots are covered in dust.
I look up, neck stretched.
The leader has stopped behind you.
I can run faster than you.
It hurts; I shrink back.
A length of my tail feathers was trampled off.

lines.zh: 我缩着脖子，往同伴身后躲。
lines.en: I tuck my neck and hide behind my packmates.

lines.zh: 它们围过来，把我挡在里侧。
lines.en: They close around me and shield me on the inside.
That twisted me.
Limping, but I can still run.
I flatten out and pant.
The leader glances at me.

lines.zh: 你的落点比我以为的准。
lines.en: Your hits landed surer than I assumed.
I need to get behind the slab.
That sack smells of meat.
You hold it up high.
I trot over.
I know that smell.
I stretch my neck out to sniff.
There are more of us behind me.
Give first and I won't snatch.
This beats insects.
I stop and wait for you to set it down.
One more small step.
You hit me and I skip to one side.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽扫过你的靴面。
lines.en: My tail feathers sweep across your boots.

lines.zh: 我的爪子挂到你的裤脚。
lines.en: My claw snags your trouser leg.
Don't push; there are many of us.
We collide and dust flies.
You step on my tail feathers.
I duck under the slab.
That made me stumble.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我蹦到一边去了。
lines.en: You hit me and I spring aside.
A few of us close in.
Another sidles up to me.

lines.zh: 头领在旁边，尾巴碰尾巴。
lines.en: The leader's beside me, tail to tail.
Its feathers are brighter than mine.
We crouch on the same slab.

lines.zh: 它替我理了理脖子上的毛。
lines.en: It preens the feathers on my neck.
Our calls become one.
We run through the stones together.
Side by side, our steps match.

lines.zh: 头领看着我们，没说什么。
lines.en: The leader watches and says nothing.
In this nest, we're a pair.
I snatch up a piece of meat.

lines.zh: 我一只爪子把它扣在地上。
lines.en: One claw pins it to the ground.

lines.zh: 我把偷来的食物塞进石缝。
lines.en: I stuff the stolen food into a rock crevice.
Heavier than I judged.
It rolled away; I chase two steps.
This is mine. Leave it.
I carry it off at a run.
I bite once. Tough.
I bring it to the leader.

lines.zh: 这肉放久了，可我还是叼走。
lines.en: This meat is old, but I carry it off anyway.
You touched our eggs.

lines.zh: 我连叫两声，同伴都竖起了毛。
lines.en: I call twice; my packmates' feathers rise.
The others have all looked up.
I flatten myself, waiting for the leader to move.
You've backed to the rock wall.
We spread out to surround you.
This is our nesting ground.
My claws dig in.
The leader watches from behind.
I fix on your ankle and don't let go.
A few of us have blocked the path.

lines.zh: 我们几只把石阵围成半圈。
lines.en: The pack forms a half circle through the stones.

lines.zh: 头领在后面低吼，我听懂了。
lines.en: The leader growls behind me, and I understand.
There's someone on the stone behind you.
We split and circle.
You step; we give a step.
I'm behind the stone at your flank.
We wait for the leader's word.
Every path here is ours.
You turn in place; we hold.
I edge toward your knee.
Your steps are loud here.
The food in your chest goes first.
One more step into the circle.
I slip under the slab.
A packmate circles behind you.
I wait to go in together.
Your knee is my height.
We're not afraid, only careful.
I leap and bite your knee.

lines.zh: 箱子里的食物，都是我偷的。
lines.en: Every scrap in that chest is stolen.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，往后拽。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and pull backward.
You pull back; I follow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划开你的袖子。
lines.en: My claws open your sleeve.

lines.zh: 同伴从另一边扑上来，箱子还没开。
lines.en: My packmate pounces from the other side; the chest is still shut.
That made you stumble.
I land and wheel around.
You're still up. Good.

lines.zh: 头领叫了一声，我们退开。
lines.en: The leader calls and we fall back.
I bite your belt from behind.
That tore the cloth.
You turn, and I've already run.
The food in this chest is mine.

lines.zh: 石阵里传来细碎的脚步。
lines.en: Light footsteps sound among the stones.
Several of us run out together.
I peek from behind a pillar.
One more little raptor here.
My claws land on the slab first.
The leader brings us over.

lines.zh: 洞顶的水滴落在我背上。
lines.en: A drip from the roof lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探出头，先看四周。
lines.en: I poke my head from the crevice and scan around.
We spread out and find our places.
We've just claimed this ground.

lines.zh: 我们从石缝里一只只出来。
lines.en: We come out of the cracks one by one.
My toes grip the stone's edge.
The leader calls before we move.
We've joined this field of stones.
I land in the middle of the slab.
Our scent is in the air here.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着打滚，把火压进灰里。
lines.en: I shriek and roll, pressing the fire into the dust.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上摔下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall down the steps and roll twice.
Water floods my nostrils and I flail.
The blast hurls me into the rock face.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的翅膀根。
lines.en: An arrow buries in my wing's root.
That spell stiffens my limbs.
There's little left to eat in the cave.
Lightning flashes and I dart into a crack.
The void pulls me down.
